paradiso.plot: Guided by Beatrice, Dante rises through the nine heavenly spheres, from the Moon to the fixed stars and beyond. He meets the blessed, among them saints, rulers and his own ancestor Cacciaguida, and is questioned on faith, hope and love. The poem ends in the Empyrean with a vision of God.
paradiso.title: Paradiso

la-dimora-millenaria.altTitle: The Temple of a Million Years
la-dimora-millenaria.plot: Seti is dead and Ramses takes the throne of Egypt with Nefertari as his Great Royal Wife. The new pharaoh begins his great building works, a new capital and his own temple of a million years, while his brother Shenar schemes with foreign powers to bring him down. His friend Moses starts to question his place among the Egyptians, and the Hittite threat grows in the north.
la-dimora-millenaria.title: La dimora millenaria

onyx-storm.plot: With the war against the venin escalating, Violet leaves the safety of the riders' world and heads beyond Navarre's borders in search of allies who could turn the tide, while the bond between her and Xaden is tested by what is happening to him.
onyx-storm.title: Onyx Storm

a-tale-of-two-cities.plot: Set between London and Paris before and during the French Revolution. Doctor Manette is released after eighteen years in the Bastille and reunited with his daughter Lucie, who marries Charles Darnay, a French aristocrat who has renounced his family. When the Terror reaches Darnay, his fate comes to rest with Sydney Carton, a dissolute English lawyer who loves Lucie.
a-tale-of-two-cities.title: A Tale of Two Cities

the-last-olympian.plot: The prophecy about Percy's sixteenth birthday comes due as Kronos marches on Mount Olympus, hidden above Manhattan. While the gods fight the monster Typhon, Percy and the demigods must defend New York alone in the final battle of the war.
the-last-olympian.title: The Last Olympian

the-golden-compass.plot: In a parallel world where every person has a daemon, their soul in animal form, the orphan Lyra Belacqua grows up among the scholars of Jordan College, Oxford. When her friend Roger is taken by the Gobblers, she heads north with the Gyptians carrying the alethiometer, a device that tells the truth. Among the armoured bear Iorek Byrnison and the witches, she uncovers the experiments on children at Bolvangar and the truth about her parents, Lord Asriel and Mrs Coulter.
the-golden-compass.title: The Golden Compass

red-phoenix.plot: North Korea launches a surprise invasion of the South, opening with commando raids and the assassination of key leaders, and a second Korean War begins. The story follows American and South Korean soldiers, pilots and commanders as Seoul is threatened and the allies fight to hold a line and then strike back, while in Washington and Moscow the politicians try to keep the war from widening. Red Phoenix Burning is its sequel.
red-phoenix.title: Red Phoenix

inheritance.plot: The Varden march on the capital Urû'baen, taking the Empire's cities one by one while Roran rises as a commander. Eragon and Saphira know they cannot defeat Galbatorix by strength alone and follow a riddle to a hidden place that may hold the key. The cycle closes with the final confrontation and its cost for those who survive.
inheritance.title: Inheritance

rosso-malpelo.plot: A red-haired boy works in a Sicilian sand quarry, despised by everyone because of the superstition that red hair means a wicked nature. After his father dies in a collapse he grows hard and bitter, and his only bond is with the lame boy Ranocchio, whom he protects in his own rough way. A key story of Italian verismo, later collected in Vita dei campi.
rosso-malpelo.title: Rosso Malpelo

a-knight-of-the-seven-kingdoms.plot: Three novellas set about ninety years before A Game of Thrones. Dunk, a tall and humble hedge knight, travels Westeros with his sharp-tongued young squire Egg, whose real identity is a dangerous secret. Tourneys, small feuds and a brewing rebellion show the Targaryen era from the level of the road.
a-knight-of-the-seven-kingdoms.series: A Song of Ice and Fire prequels
a-knight-of-the-seven-kingdoms.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

the-atlas-six.plot: Every ten years the secret Alexandrian Society recruits the six most gifted young magicians in the world and offers them a year among the lost knowledge of the Library of Alexandria. Six are chosen by the mysterious Atlas Blakely, but only five will be initiated. As they study together, alliances, rivalries and attraction grow, along with the question of what happens to the sixth.
the-atlas-six.title: The Atlas Six

a-dance-with-dragons.plot: Running alongside the previous book and then beyond it, this volume returns to the north and the east. Jon Snow commands the Night's Watch as winter and the Others close in, Daenerys struggles to rule Meereen while her dragons grow wild, and Tyrion flees across the Narrow Sea. Many roads begin to lead toward her.
a-dance-with-dragons.series: A Song of Ice and Fire
a-dance-with-dragons.title: A Dance with Dragons

the-assassins-blade.plot: Five prequel novellas set before Throne of Glass. They follow Celaena Sardothien as the most feared assassin in Adarlan, on missions that take her from a pirate lord's island to the Red Desert, and tell the story of her bond with fellow assassin Sam Cortland and the betrayal that sends her to the salt mines of Endovier.
the-assassins-blade.title: The Assassin's Blade

l-ultimo-nemico.plot: Ramses is now an ageing king who has ruled for decades and outlived many of those he loved. Peace with the Hittites must be sealed by a diplomatic marriage, and a final set of conspirators threatens the country from Libya and from within. The last volume follows the pharaoh through the closing years of his long reign as he faces the one enemy no ruler defeats.
l-ultimo-nemico.title: L'ultimo nemico

how-to-hide-an-empire.altTitle: A History of the Greater United States
how-to-hide-an-empire.plot: A history of the United States told through the territories that the familiar map leaves out: the guano islands, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Alaska, Guam and hundreds of overseas bases. Immerwahr shows how the country acquired and ruled these places, how their people were treated, and how after the Second World War it swapped colonies for a subtler kind of reach built on bases, technology, standards and the English language.
how-to-hide-an-empire.title: How to Hide an Empire

the-man-in-the-high-castle.plot: It is 1962 and the Axis won the Second World War. The former United States is split between a Japanese-run Pacific coast, a Nazi-controlled East and a neutral buffer zone in the Rockies. In San Francisco an antiques dealer, a Japanese trade official, a forger of Americana and a judo teacher lead lives shaped by the I Ching and by a banned novel, The Grasshopper Lies Heavy, which imagines a world where the Allies won. Juliana Frink sets out to find its author, the man in the high castle.
the-man-in-the-high-castle.title: The Man in the High Castle

overthrow.altTitle: America's Century of Regime Change from Hawaii to Iraq
overthrow.plot: A history of fourteen foreign governments the United States helped bring down over about 110 years, from the Hawaiian monarchy in 1893 through Cuba, the Philippines, Nicaragua, Iran, Guatemala, South Vietnam and Chile to Afghanistan and Iraq. Kinzer looks at who pushed for each intervention, the mix of business interests and ideology behind it, and what it left behind for the countries involved and for the United States.
overthrow.title: Overthrow

rainbow-six.plot: John Clark commands Rainbow, a multinational counter-terrorism unit based in England, with Ding Chavez leading one of its teams. After a string of hostage crises in Switzerland, Austria and Spain, it emerges that the attacks are being steered by a group of radical environmentalists tied to a pharmaceutical multinational, bent on wiping out humanity with a virus released at the Sydney Olympics.
rainbow-six.title: Rainbow Six

brisingr.plot: Bound by promises to Roran, to the Varden and to the dwarves, Eragon is pulled in every direction as the war against the Empire spreads. He needs a new sword worthy of a Rider and answers about how Galbatorix grows ever stronger. What he learns in Ellesméra changes what he knows about his own family and about the king's power.
brisingr.title: Brisingr

eragon.plot: Eragon, a farm boy in the land of Alagaësia, finds a blue stone in the mountains that hatches into the dragon Saphira. When the servants of the tyrant king Galbatorix destroy his home, he flees with the old storyteller Brom, who trains him in swordsmanship and magic as one of the last Dragon Riders. Hunted across the Empire, Eragon makes his way toward the rebel Varden.
eragon.title: Eragon

harry-potter-7.altTitle: Harry Potter e i Doni della Morte
harry-potter-7.plot: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave school and live as fugitives to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes while Voldemort takes over the Ministry. Along the way they discover the legend of the three Deathly Hallows and Dumbledore's less than spotless past. Everything converges on the Battle of Hogwarts, where Snape's true loyalty comes out and Harry faces Voldemort for the last time.
harry-potter-7.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

eldest.plot: After the battle of Farthen Dûr, Eragon and Saphira travel to the elven forest of Ellesméra to complete their training as Rider and dragon. Meanwhile his cousin Roran must defend the village of Carvahall from the Empire and lead its people on a desperate journey south. The two stories meet as war between the Varden and Galbatorix breaks out.
eldest.title: Eldest

a-storm-of-swords.plot: The war of the kings reaches its bloodiest turns as alliances are made and broken by marriage and betrayal. Robb Stark wins battles but risks losing the war, Jon Snow lives among the wildlings as they march on the Wall, and Daenerys begins to conquer the slave cities of the east. It is the volume where the fate of several great houses is decided.
a-storm-of-swords.series: A Song of Ice and Fire
a-storm-of-swords.title: A Storm of Swords

around-the-world-in-eighty-days.altTitle: Il giro del mondo in 80 giorni
around-the-world-in-eighty-days.plot: The methodical London gentleman Phileas Fogg bets twenty thousand pounds with his fellow members of the Reform Club that he can travel around the world in eighty days. He sets off with his French valet Passepartout by train, steamer and elephant, rescues the young Aouda in India, and is trailed by Inspector Fix, who is convinced he is a bank robber. He believes he has arrived too late, but by travelling east he has gained a day.
around-the-world-in-eighty-days.title: Around the World in Eighty Days

without-remorse.plot: Baltimore, 1970. Former Navy SEAL John Kelly, already a widower, also loses Pam, a girl who had escaped a drug-trafficking gang, and begins eliminating its members one by one with military method. Meanwhile the CIA recruits him for an operation to rescue American prisoners from a North Vietnamese camp. The two threads end with Kelly's official death and the birth of John Clark.
without-remorse.title: Without Remorse

i-malavoglia.altTitle: The House by the Medlar Tree
i-malavoglia.plot: In Aci Trezza the Toscano family, known as the Malavoglia, lives off the boat Provvidenza under old Padron 'Ntoni. To better their lot they buy a cargo of lupins on credit, but the boat is wrecked, Bastianazzo dies and the debt takes the house by the medlar tree as well. Bereavements follow, along with young 'Ntoni's smuggling and prison and Lia's ruin, until Alessi manages to buy the house back.
i-malavoglia.title: I Malavoglia

gli-ultimi-filibustieri.plot: The last chapter of the corsair saga. The age of the Brethren of the Coast is ending, and the remaining filibusters, among them the Gascon Don Barrejo and his companions, undertake one more expedition across the isthmus toward the Pacific to protect the heir of the Ventimiglia family.
gli-ultimi-filibustieri.title: Gli ultimi filibustieri

the-silmarillion.plot: The myths and ancient history of Tolkien's world, published after his death. It tells of the creation of the world, the making of the three jewels called Silmarils and the long, tragic war of the Elves against the first Dark Lord Morgoth, down to the forging of the Rings of Power.
the-silmarillion.title: The Silmarillion

iliad.plot: In the tenth year of the Trojan War, the Greek hero Achilles quarrels with his commander Agamemnon and withdraws from the fighting in anger. Without him the Greeks are driven back to their ships by Hector and the Trojans, with the gods taking sides. The death of his friend Patroclus brings Achilles back to battle and to his duel with Hector.
iliad.title: Iliad

dragonflight.plot: On the planet Pern, human colonists bred telepathic, fire-breathing dragons to burn Thread out of the sky. Thread is a silvery spore that falls from the Red Star and devours any living thing it touches. After four hundred years without a fall, most people think the danger is a legend and the dragonriders have dwindled to a single Weyr. Lessa, the last survivor of a murdered ruling family, bonds with the golden queen Ramoth, and with F'lar, rider of the bronze Mnementh, she must prepare a doubting world as Thread returns.
dragonflight.title: Dragonflight

assassins-creed-6.plot: Edward Kenway leaves Wales and his wife to seek his fortune as a privateer in the Caribbean and ends up a pirate alongside Blackbeard and Benjamin Hornigold. After putting on a dead Assassin's robes by chance, he finds himself in the middle of the war between Assassins and Templars over the Observatory, and only after many losses does he choose a side.
assassins-creed-6.title: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag

il-principe.plot: A political treatise dedicated to Lorenzo de' Medici on how a state is won and kept. Machiavelli classifies the kinds of principality, weighs citizen armies against mercenaries, and argues that a prince must know how to be both fox and lion, and should prefer being feared to being loved when he cannot be both. Cesare Borgia is the recurring model, and the book ends with a call to free Italy from foreigners.
il-principe.title: Il principe

assassins-creed-4.plot: An ageing Ezio travels to Masyaf in search of Altaïr's library and finds that opening it takes five keys hidden in Constantinople. In the Ottoman capital he allies with the local Assassins and the young prince Suleiman, fights the Byzantine Templars and meets Sofia Sartor.
assassins-creed-4.title: Assassin's Creed: Revelations

i-tre-moschettieri.plot: France, 1625. The young Gascon d'Artagnan comes to Paris to join the King's Musketeers and becomes the friend of Athos, Porthos and Aramis. Together they defend the honour of the Queen against the plots of Cardinal Richelieu and his agent, the beautiful and deadly Milady de Winter, in a chase for the Queen's diamonds that takes them to England and back.
i-tre-moschettieri.title: I tre moschettieri

l-ultima-legione.plot: In 476 AD the Western Roman Empire falls and the boy emperor Romulus Augustus is taken prisoner by the barbarians. A handful of loyal soldiers from the last legion, with a mysterious tutor called Ambrosinus, set out to free him and carry him to safety across Europe. Their flight north toward Britannia ties the end of Rome to the beginning of a famous legend.
l-ultima-legione.title: L'ultima legione

the-sword-of-summer.plot: Magnus Chase, a homeless teenager in Boston, learns he is the son of a Norse god and dies on his sixteenth birthday defending the city. He wakes in Valhalla as one of Odin's warriors and sets out to recover the Sword of Summer and keep the wolf Fenris bound, delaying Ragnarok.
the-sword-of-summer.series: Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard
the-sword-of-summer.title: The Sword of Summer

war-and-peace.plot: Russia during the Napoleonic wars, from 1805 to the French invasion of 1812. The novel follows several aristocratic families, above all the awkward heir Pierre Bezukhov, the proud Prince Andrei Bolkonsky and the lively young Natasha Rostova. Their loves, losses and searches for meaning unfold against Austerlitz, Borodino and the burning of Moscow.
war-and-peace.title: War and Peace

a-game-of-thrones.plot: Lord Eddard Stark of Winterfell is called south to serve as Hand to his old friend King Robert Baratheon and finds a court full of plots around the powerful Lannister family. In the far north the Night's Watch guards the Wall against something older than men, and across the sea the exiled Daenerys Targaryen is married to a Dothraki warlord. The death of a king tips the Seven Kingdoms toward war.
a-game-of-thrones.series: A Song of Ice and Fire
a-game-of-thrones.title: A Game of Thrones

purgatorio.plot: Dante and Virgil climb the mountain of Purgatory, which rises from the ocean on the far side of the world. On its seven terraces souls are cleansed of the seven deadly sins, with hope instead of despair. At the summit, in the Earthly Paradise, Virgil can go no further and Beatrice takes his place as guide.
purgatorio.title: Purgatorio

assassins-creed-5.plot: The diary of Haytham Kenway, from a London childhood marked by his father's murder to his years as Templar Grand Master in the American colonies. It is the story of Assassin's Creed III seen from the other side, with the impossible relationship between Haytham and his son Connor, raised among the Mohawk and turned Assassin.
assassins-creed-5.title: Assassin's Creed: Forsaken

la-regina-di-abu-simbel.plot: After Kadesh, Ramses works toward a lasting peace with the Hittites while enemies still plot inside Egypt. Moses returns and asks the pharaoh to let the Hebrews leave, setting the two old friends against each other. In Nubia Ramses builds the twin temples of Abu Simbel in honour of Nefertari, whose health is failing under a dark spell.
la-regina-di-abu-simbel.title: La regina di Abu Simbel

dubliners.plot: Fifteen short stories about ordinary middle-class life in Dublin in the early twentieth century. They move from childhood to adolescence, maturity and public life, and show people caught in routine, religion and missed chances, often at a moment of sudden self-understanding. The book closes with The Dead.
dubliners.title: Dubliners

assassins-creed-1.plot: Florence, 1476. Young Ezio Auditore sees his father and brothers hanged over a conspiracy and learns he descends from an order of Assassins. Trained by his uncle Mario and helped by Leonardo da Vinci, he hunts the conspirators across Florence, Tuscany and Venice, working his way up to Rodrigo Borgia and the Templars.
assassins-creed-1.title: Assassin's Creed: Renaissance

il-figlio-della-luce.plot: Egypt, thirteenth century BC. The young prince Ramses is the second son of Pharaoh Seti, who puts him through a series of harsh trials to see whether he is fit to rule. His elder brother Shenar expects the throne and plots against him. Ramses grows up alongside his friends Moses, Setau, Ameni and Asha, meets Nefertari, and learns what it means to carry the power of a pharaoh.
il-figlio-della-luce.title: Il figlio della luce

leviathan-wakes.plot: Two centuries from now humanity has spread through the solar system, with Earth, Mars and the Belt in an uneasy balance. Jim Holden, executive officer of an ice hauler, answers a distress call from a derelict ship and stumbles on a secret that someone will kill to keep. On Ceres, the worn-out detective Miller is hired to find a missing rich girl, Julie Mao. Their paths cross as the system slides toward war and something far stranger comes to light.
leviathan-wakes.title: Leviathan Wakes

the-battle-of-the-labyrinth.plot: Kronos's army plans to invade Camp Half-Blood through Daedalus's Labyrinth, a living maze that stretches under the whole country. Percy and his friends go underground to find its inventor and stop the attack before it reaches the camp.
the-battle-of-the-labyrinth.title: The Battle of the Labyrinth

ventimila-leghe-sotto-i-mari.altTitle: Vingt mille lieues sous les mers
ventimila-leghe-sotto-i-mari.plot: In 1866 ships report a giant sea monster, and the naturalist Professor Aronnax joins an expedition to hunt it with his servant Conseil and the harpooner Ned Land. The monster is the Nautilus, a submarine built by the mysterious Captain Nemo, who takes the three aboard as permanent guests. They travel the oceans of the world, from coral forests and Atlantis to the South Pole and a battle with giant squid.
ventimila-leghe-sotto-i-mari.title: Ventimila leghe sotto i mari

crown-of-midnight.plot: Now the King's Champion, Celaena Sardothien is sent to kill the enemies of the crown, but she secretly fakes their deaths and lets them escape. Ordered to eliminate a rebel she once knew, she is pulled into a conspiracy around the king's hidden source of power while growing closer to Chaol, the captain of the guard. A brutal loss shatters her loyalties, and the book ends by revealing who she really is.
crown-of-midnight.title: Crown of Midnight

iron-flame.plot: Violet begins her second year at Basgiath knowing what the leadership has been hiding, and with a new vice commandant determined to break her. As she and Xaden keep the secret from those around them, she has to decide who to trust while a war beyond the border comes closer.
iron-flame.title: Iron Flame

the-hunt-for-red-october.plot: At the height of the Cold War, Soviet captain Marko Ramius puts to sea in Red October, a nuclear submarine with a nearly undetectable drive, and heads for America. Moscow sends its fleet to sink him and Washington fears an attack. CIA analyst Jack Ryan is the only one who guesses that Ramius means to defect, and he has to prove it before someone opens fire.
the-hunt-for-red-october.title: The Hunt for Red October

la-battaglia-di-qadesh.plot: The Hittite empire moves against Egypt and Ramses must lead his army north into Syria. Spies and traitors at court have weakened him from within, and his troops walk into a trap beneath the walls of the fortress of Kadesh. Almost alone on the battlefield, the pharaoh has to turn a disaster into the battle that will define his reign.
la-battaglia-di-qadesh.title: La battaglia di Qadesh

anna-karenina.plot: Anna, the wife of a senior Saint Petersburg official, falls in love with the cavalry officer Count Vronsky and leaves her marriage for him, at the cost of her place in society and her son. In parallel the landowner Levin courts Kitty and looks for an honest way to live through work, family and faith. The two stories set passion against the search for a settled life.
anna-karenina.title: Anna Karenina

a-court-of-frost-and-starlight.plot: A short novel set in the months after the war. Feyre, Rhysand and their friends rebuild the Night Court and prepare for the Winter Solstice, while each of them carries wounds from the fighting that the celebrations cannot quite cover. It bridges the first trilogy and the books that follow.
a-court-of-frost-and-starlight.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
a-court-of-frost-and-starlight.title: A Court of Frost and Starlight

the-picture-of-dorian-gray.plot: The beautiful young Dorian Gray has his portrait painted and, under the influence of the cynical Lord Henry, wishes that the picture would grow old in his place. The wish comes true. Dorian lives a life of pleasure and cruelty while his face stays perfect and the hidden portrait records every sin.
the-picture-of-dorian-gray.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray

the-titans-curse.plot: A rescue mission goes wrong and Annabeth disappears, along with the goddess Artemis. Percy joins a quest with the Hunters of Artemis and the two newly found di Angelo siblings, racing west before the winter solstice while the Titan lord Kronos gathers strength.
the-titans-curse.title: The Titan's Curse

a-court-of-silver-flames.plot: The focus shifts to Feyre's sister Nesta, proud, angry and struggling since she was forced into the Cauldron and made High Fae. Sent to train with the warrior Cassian, she has to face her own trauma while the human queens who returned from the war forge a dangerous new alliance.
a-court-of-silver-flames.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
a-court-of-silver-flames.title: A Court of Silver Flames

the-mark-of-zorro.plot: Spanish California in the early nineteenth century. A masked rider called Zorro defends the poor and the natives against corrupt officials and carves a Z with his sword. Nobody suspects the idle young nobleman Don Diego Vega, who is courting Lolita Pulido while she falls for the outlaw instead. First published as The Curse of Capistrano.
the-mark-of-zorro.title: The Mark of Zorro

red-storm-rising.plot: After saboteurs destroy a key Soviet oil refinery, the Politburo decides to seize the Persian Gulf oilfields and, to keep NATO out of the way, first launches a conventional war in Europe. The fighting is followed from several sides at once: a tank war in Germany, the Soviet capture of Iceland, and the battle to keep convoys crossing the Atlantic against submarines and bombers. Written with Larry Bond, it stands apart from the Jack Ryan books.
red-storm-rising.title: Red Storm Rising

windhaven.plot: Windhaven is a stormy ocean world of scattered islands, settled long ago by the survivors of a crashed starship. The islands stay in touch through the flyers, an elite caste who glide on wings cut from the ship's metal sail. The wings cannot be replaced, so they pass from parent to child. Maris of Lesser Amberly, a fisherman's daughter raised by a flyer, loves the sky more than anyone, yet tradition says her wings must go to her stepbrother Coll, who only wants to be a singer. Her challenge to that rule opens flying to anyone who can win wings in competition. The book follows her through three stages of her life as she faces what that change costs, including the bitter rise of the outsider Val One-Wing and the widening rift between flyers and the land-bound.
windhaven.title: Windhaven

into-the-wild.plot: A reconstruction of the true story of Christopher McCandless, a young man from a well-off family who in 1990, fresh out of college, gives his savings to charity, abandons his car and roams America for two years under the name Alexander Supertramp. In April 1992 he walks alone into Alaska along the Stampede Trail and lives in an abandoned bus, where he is found dead of starvation four months later. Krakauer follows his trail, interviews the people who met him and weaves in his own experiences as a climber.
into-the-wild.title: Into the Wild

jolanda-la-figlia-del-corsaro-nero.plot: Years later Jolanda, daughter of the Black Corsair, sails to the Caribbean to claim her inheritance and is taken prisoner by the Spanish. Morgan, her father's former lieutenant, sets out to free her with his old companions Carmaux and Wan Stiller. The pursuit runs from Maracaibo to the sack of Panama.
jolanda-la-figlia-del-corsaro-nero.title: Jolanda, la figlia del Corsaro Nero

red-phoenix-burning.plot: A sequel to Red Phoenix, set decades after the second Korean War of the first book. North Korea's regime starts to come apart, and as rival factions fight for control the danger grows that its nuclear weapons fall into the wrong hands or get used. American and South Korean forces, special operators and politicians race to contain the crisis while China watches across the border and the peninsula edges toward a new war.
red-phoenix-burning.title: Red Phoenix Burning

the-sea-of-monsters.plot: The magical borders of Camp Half-Blood are failing because the tree that protects them has been poisoned. Percy, Annabeth and his new half-brother Tyson sail into the Sea of Monsters to find the Golden Fleece and to rescue Grover from a Cyclops.
the-sea-of-monsters.title: The Sea of Monsters

queen-of-shadows.plot: The heroine returns to Rifthold under her true name, set on settling scores with her former master Arobynn Hamel, rescuing those she loves and confronting the King of Adarlan to free magic.
queen-of-shadows.title: Queen of Shadows

lean-analytics.altTitle: Use Data to Build a Better Startup Faster
lean-analytics.plot: A practical guide to measuring a startup, part of Eric Ries's Lean series. The authors argue that at any moment a company should focus on the One Metric That Matters, and they walk through five stages of growth (empathy, stickiness, virality, revenue, scale) and six common business models, from e-commerce and SaaS to marketplaces and mobile apps. Each comes with the numbers worth tracking and rough benchmarks for what good looks like, illustrated with dozens of case studies.
lean-analytics.title: Lean Analytics

the-two-towers.plot: The Fellowship is broken. Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli pursue the orcs who took Merry and Pippin and are drawn into the war of Rohan against the wizard Saruman. Frodo and Sam go on toward Mordor alone, guided by Gollum, the creature who once owned the Ring.
the-two-towers.title: The Two Towers

tower-of-dawn.plot: Running parallel to Empire of Storms, this book follows Chaol Westfall and Nesryn Faliq to the southern continent. Chaol seeks healing from the famed healers of the Torre Cesme, in particular the reluctant Yrene Towers, and both try to win the khagan's armies for the war in the north.
tower-of-dawn.title: Tower of Dawn

i-promessi-sposi.plot: In Lombardy under Spanish rule in 1628, the silk weaver Renzo and his fiancée Lucia are about to marry when the local lord Don Rodrigo forbids the wedding because he wants Lucia for himself. The couple are forced to flee and are separated. Bread riots in Milan, war, the terrible Innominato and the plague of 1630 stand between them before they can find each other again.
i-promessi-sposi.title: I promessi sposi

twelve-years-a-slave.plot: The memoir of Solomon Northup, a free Black man and violinist from Saratoga Springs, New York. In 1841 two men lure him to Washington with the promise of work, drug him and sell him into slavery. Renamed Platt, he spends twelve years on plantations in Louisiana, above all under the brutal Edwin Epps, until a Canadian carpenter, Samuel Bass, agrees to send letters north and his family secures his release in 1853.
twelve-years-a-slave.title: Twelve Years a Slave

fuochi-d-artificio.plot: Piedmont Alps, 1944. With the war and the German occupation pressing on their valley, a group of children led by twelve-year-old Marta decide to help the partisans in secret. To cover their tracks they invent a partisan who does not exist, Sandokan, and his legend soon grows bigger than they are. A story of the Resistance seen through the courage and the games of kids.
fuochi-d-artificio.title: Fuochi d'artificio

a-court-of-wings-and-ruin.plot: Feyre returns to the Spring Court as a spy to learn what Tamlin and the invading king of Hybern are planning. As war closes in on Prythian, she and Rhysand must work out which of the High Lords can be trusted and look for allies in unexpected places.
a-court-of-wings-and-ruin.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
a-court-of-wings-and-ruin.title: A Court of Wings and Ruin

the-culture-of-narcissism.plot: A critique of American society in the 1970s. Lasch argues that consumer capitalism, bureaucracy and the decline of family and community authority have produced a personality that is self-absorbed, anxious and dependent on the approval of others. He traces the pattern through politics, work, sport, education and the fear of ageing.
the-culture-of-narcissism.title: The Culture of Narcissism

the-green-mile.plot: Louisiana, 1932. Paul Edgecombe is the head guard on death row at Cold Mountain penitentiary, where the last corridor to the electric chair is called the Green Mile. A new prisoner arrives, John Coffey, a huge and gentle man condemned for the murder of two little girls. Coffey turns out to have a miraculous gift for healing, and Paul begins to doubt that he is guilty.
the-green-mile.title: Il miglio verde

don-quixote.plot: An ageing gentleman from La Mancha reads so many romances of chivalry that he decides to become a knight errant. As Don Quixote, with the peasant Sancho Panza as his squire, he rides out to right wrongs, taking inns for castles and windmills for giants. The second part, of 1615, finds the pair already famous and the joke turning sadder.
don-quixote.title: Don Quixote

robin-hood.plot: In twelfth-century England young Robin, raised by a forester in Sherwood, learns he is the rightful heir to the earldom of Huntingdon, which he was cheated out of. Declared an outlaw by the Baron of Nottingham, he gathers a band of companions including Little John and Friar Tuck, robs the powerful to help the poor and fights for the love of Marian.
robin-hood.title: Robin Hood

fire-and-blood.plot: Written as a chronicle by an archmaester of the Citadel, this prequel tells the history of House Targaryen from Aegon the Conqueror's landing in Westeros, about three hundred years before A Game of Thrones. It follows the kings who came after him and the civil war known as the Dance of the Dragons, when the dynasty and its dragons turned on each other.
fire-and-blood.series: A Song of Ice and Fire prequels
fire-and-blood.title: Fire & Blood

a-court-of-thorns-and-roses.altTitle: La corte di rose e spine
a-court-of-thorns-and-roses.plot: Feyre, a young huntress keeping her poor family alive, kills a wolf in the woods that turns out to be a faerie. As payment she is taken across the wall to the Spring Court, the land of the High Fae lord Tamlin. Her fear slowly turns into love, but a curse hangs over the court and she is the one who can break it.
a-court-of-thorns-and-roses.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
a-court-of-thorns-and-roses.title: A Court of Thorns and Roses

assassins-creed-8.plot: London, 1862. The disgraced Indian Assassin Jayadeep Mir lives under a false name among the workers digging the first underground railway, in order to infiltrate the Templars who control the city. It is the prequel to Syndicate: years later, as Henry Green, he will meet the twins Jacob and Evie Frye.
assassins-creed-8.title: Assassin's Creed: Underworld

la-coscienza-di-zeno.plot: Zeno Cosini, a comfortable Trieste businessman, writes his memoirs at the urging of his psychoanalyst, who then publishes them out of spite when Zeno breaks off the treatment. What emerges is the ironic portrait of an inept man: the endless last cigarettes, the slap from his dying father, marriage to the wrong sister, the mistress, the rivalry with his brother-in-law Guido. In the end Zeno declares himself cured and imagines an explosion that rids the Earth of the disease of mankind.
la-coscienza-di-zeno.title: La coscienza di Zeno

il-corsaro-nero.plot: The Caribbean, seventeenth century. Emilio di Roccabruna, lord of Ventimiglia, has become the Black Corsair to avenge his brothers, killed by the Flemish governor Van Guld. With the buccaneers of Tortuga he attacks Maracaibo and swears to destroy his enemy's whole family. Then he falls in love with a young duchess without knowing who her father is.
il-corsaro-nero.title: Il Corsaro Nero

a-clash-of-kings.plot: With the realm split, five men claim a crown and the War of the Five Kings tears Westeros apart. Tyrion Lannister tries to hold King's Landing together as acting Hand while Stannis Baratheon sails against it. Beyond the Wall Jon Snow rides with the Night's Watch, and Daenerys crosses the wastes with her newborn dragons.
a-clash-of-kings.series: A Song of Ice and Fire
a-clash-of-kings.title: A Clash of Kings

the-fellowship-of-the-ring.plot: Frodo Baggins inherits Bilbo's ring and learns from Gandalf that it is the One Ring of the Dark Lord Sauron. Hunted by the Black Riders, he flees the Shire for Rivendell, where a fellowship of nine is formed to take the Ring to Mordor and destroy it.
the-fellowship-of-the-ring.title: The Fellowship of the Ring

murtagh.plot: A year after the fall of Galbatorix, Murtagh and his red dragon Thorn live as outcasts, hated across Alagaësia for what they were forced to do in the king's service. Rumours of brittle ground and a smell of brimstone lead them north on the trail of a mysterious witch. What they find is a threat older and stranger than the war they survived, and a test of the bond between Rider and dragon.
murtagh.title: Murtagh

harry-potter-6.altTitle: Harry Potter e il principe mezzosangue
harry-potter-6.plot: With the war now in the open, Dumbledore shows Harry the memories that piece together Tom Riddle's past and the secret of his immortality: the Horcruxes. Meanwhile Harry excels at Potions thanks to an old textbook annotated by a mysterious Half-Blood Prince and suspects Draco Malfoy is plotting something. The year ends with Death Eaters inside Hogwarts and a betrayal at the top of the Astronomy Tower.
harry-potter-6.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

the-return-of-the-king.plot: Sauron's armies besiege Minas Tirith and Aragorn must claim his inheritance to lead the free peoples in the last battles. Far away Frodo and Sam cross the wasteland of Mordor toward Mount Doom, where the fate of the Ring and of Middle-earth is decided.
the-return-of-the-king.title: The Return of the King

kingdom-of-ash.plot: The final book of the series. The queen is held captive by Maeve while her friends and allies are scattered across the continent, fighting separate battles against Erawan's armies. All the threads converge on a last stand for the fate of the world.
kingdom-of-ash.title: Kingdom of Ash

jekyll-and-hyde.altTitle: Lo strano caso del dottor Jekyll e del signor Hyde
jekyll-and-hyde.plot: In London the lawyer Utterson looks into the link between his friend, the respected Dr Henry Jekyll, and a certain Edward Hyde, a repellent and violent man whom Jekyll has named as his heir. After a brutal murder and Hyde's disappearance, the doctor's final confession reveals everything: with a potion he separated out his own evil side, which little by little took over.
jekyll-and-hyde.title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde

a-feast-for-crows.plot: The great battles are over and the survivors pick over a ruined kingdom. Cersei Lannister rules in King's Landing with growing paranoia, Brienne searches the war-torn riverlands for Sansa Stark, and new players stir in Dorne and the Iron Islands. The story focuses on the south of Westeros while other characters wait for the next volume.
a-feast-for-crows.series: A Song of Ice and Fire
a-feast-for-crows.title: A Feast for Crows

harry-potter-3.altTitle: Harry Potter e il prigioniero di Azkaban
harry-potter-3.plot: Sirius Black, believed to be Voldemort's accomplice and the man who betrayed Harry's parents, escapes from Azkaban prison and seems to be heading for Hogwarts. The school is guarded by Dementors, which affect Harry terribly, and the new teacher Lupin shows him how to defend himself. The truth about Black and that night twelve years earlier turns out to be very different from the official version.
harry-potter-3.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

le-tigri-di-mompracem.plot: Sandokan, a dispossessed Bornean prince turned pirate and known as the Tiger of Malaysia, leads his men from the island of Mompracem against the British who destroyed his family. With his loyal Portuguese friend Yanez he hears of a girl called the Pearl of Labuan. He falls in love with Marianna, the niece of an English officer, and risks everything to carry her away.
le-tigri-di-mompracem.title: Le tigri di Mompracem

the-ship-of-the-dead.plot: Loki is free and preparing Naglfar, the ship of the dead, to sail and begin Ragnarok. Magnus and his crew cross the seas of the Nine Worlds to reach it before midsummer and challenge the trickster god to a contest of insults.
the-ship-of-the-dead.series: Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard
the-ship-of-the-dead.title: The Ship of the Dead

the-hobbit.plot: Bilbo Baggins, a comfort-loving hobbit, is swept off by the wizard Gandalf and thirteen dwarves on a journey to win back their treasure from the dragon Smaug. On the way he meets trolls, goblins and elves, and in a dark cave under the mountains he finds a ring that makes its wearer invisible.
the-hobbit.title: The Hobbit

harry-potter-5.altTitle: Harry Potter e l'Ordine della Fenice
harry-potter-5.plot: The Ministry of Magic denies Voldemort's return and discredits Harry and Dumbledore, sending Dolores Umbridge to take control of Hogwarts. Harry secretly trains his classmates in Dumbledore's Army while the Order of the Phoenix regroups. Tormented by visions that tie him to Voldemort's mind, he is lured to the Department of Mysteries, where he learns of the prophecy about him and suffers a heavy loss.
harry-potter-5.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

the-longest-day.plot: An hour-by-hour account of 6 June 1944, the Allied landings in Normandy, built from hundreds of interviews with those who were there: American, British, Canadian and German soldiers, Resistance fighters and French civilians. Ryan follows the waiting on the eve, the night-time paratrooper drops, the landings on the five beaches and the confusion in the German command, with Rommel away from the front and Hitler asleep.
the-longest-day.title: The Longest Day

the-lightning-thief.plot: Twelve-year-old Percy Jackson discovers that the Greek gods are real and that he is the son of Poseidon. Accused of stealing Zeus's master lightning bolt, he has ten days to cross America with Annabeth and the satyr Grover, find the true thief and prevent a war among the gods.
the-lightning-thief.title: The Lightning Thief

assassins-creed-2.plot: After the Borgia attack on Monteriggioni, Ezio moves to Rome, a city in ruins under the rule of Cesare Borgia. There he rebuilds the Assassin brotherhood, recruiting allies among thieves, courtesans and mercenaries, and dismantles the family's power piece by piece until the final confrontation with Cesare.
assassins-creed-2.title: Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood

odyssey.plot: After the fall of Troy, Odysseus spends ten years trying to sail home to Ithaca, facing the Cyclops, Circe, the Sirens and the anger of Poseidon. At home his wife Penelope holds off a crowd of suitors who want his throne, and his son Telemachus goes looking for news of him. Odysseus must finally return in disguise to reclaim his house.
odyssey.title: Odyssey

assassins-creed-3.plot: Niccolò Polo tells the life of Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad, a master assassin in the Holy Land during the Third Crusade. Demoted for his arrogance, Altaïr must eliminate nine targets to regain his rank, uncovers the betrayal of his mentor Al Mualim, and spends the rest of his life defending the order and studying the Apple of Eden.
assassins-creed-3.title: Assassin's Creed: The Secret Crusade

empire-of-storms.plot: With war coming, the young queen travels across the continent gathering allies and an armada to stand against the dark lord Erawan, while searching for the means to defeat him. Old debts and Queen Maeve's schemes catch up with her along the way.
empire-of-storms.title: Empire of Storms

throne-of-glass.plot: Celaena Sardothien, an eighteen-year-old assassin, is pulled out of the salt mines of Endovier by the crown prince with an offer. If she wins a deadly competition to become the king's champion and serves him for four years, she goes free. While she trains in the glass castle, contestants start turning up dead and she uncovers something darker at work.
throne-of-glass.title: Throne of Glass

inferno.plot: Lost in a dark wood halfway through his life, Dante is met by the Roman poet Virgil, who leads him down through the nine circles of Hell. In each circle the damned suffer a punishment that mirrors their sin, and Dante speaks with figures from myth, history and the Florence of his own day. The journey ends at the frozen centre of the earth, where Lucifer is held.
inferno.title: Inferno

a-court-of-mist-and-fury.plot: After the events Under the Mountain, Feyre is now High Fae and engaged to Tamlin, but she is haunted by what she did and stifled by his protectiveness. Her bargain with Rhysand, High Lord of the Night Court, pulls her into his world, where she learns to use her new powers and discovers a far larger threat gathering against Prythian.
a-court-of-mist-and-fury.series: A Court of Thorns and Roses
a-court-of-mist-and-fury.title: A Court of Mist and Fury

harry-potter-cursed-child.altTitle: Harry Potter e la maledizione dell'erede
harry-potter-cursed-child.plot: A play script set nineteen years after the Battle of Hogwarts. Albus, Harry's middle child, is sorted into Slytherin, struggles under the weight of his surname and becomes friends with Scorpius Malfoy. With a stolen Time-Turner the two try to go back and save Cedric Diggory, and every attempt rewrites the present into ever worse versions.
harry-potter-cursed-child.title: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child

the-hammer-of-thor.plot: Thor's hammer is missing again and the giants are ready to invade Midgard. To get it back Magnus and his friends must deal with Loki, who is arranging a wedding that nobody wants, and with a new arrival in Valhalla, the shapeshifter Alex Fierro.
the-hammer-of-thor.series: Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard
the-hammer-of-thor.title: The Hammer of Thor

harry-potter-2.altTitle: Harry Potter e la camera dei segreti
harry-potter-2.plot: In Harry's second year at Hogwarts something is petrifying Muggle-born students, and writing on the walls announces that the Chamber of Secrets has been opened again. Harry hears a voice no one else can hear and is suspected of being the heir of Slytherin. The trail leads to an old diary that belonged to a certain Tom Riddle and to the monster hidden beneath the school.
harry-potter-2.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

il-figlio-del-corsaro-rosso.plot: Enrico di Ventimiglia, son of the hanged Red Corsair, comes to the Americas to find his half-sister, born to an indigenous princess, and to punish the man responsible for his father's death. Helped by a band of filibusters he crosses Santo Domingo and Panama in search of her.
il-figlio-del-corsaro-rosso.title: Il figlio del Corsaro Rosso

strangers-on-a-bridge.plot: The first-person account of New York lawyer James Donovan, based on his diaries and the trial record. In 1957 he agrees to defend Colonel Rudolf Abel, a Soviet spy arrested in Brooklyn, and despite widespread hostility keeps him from the electric chair, arguing that he might one day be useful for an exchange. In 1962 Donovan himself negotiates in East Berlin the handover of Abel for U-2 pilot Francis Gary Powers on the Glienicke Bridge.
strangers-on-a-bridge.title: Strangers on a Bridge

la-grande-storia-della-prima-guerra-mond.plot: A military history of the First World War by a British oral historian of the Imperial War Museum. Hart follows the fighting front by front, from the opening moves of 1914 through the Somme, Verdun and the war at sea to the final offensives of 1918. He explains the strategy and the weapons and lets soldiers' own letters and testimonies describe what the battles were like.
la-grande-storia-della-prima-guerra-mond.title: La grande storia della prima guerra mondiale

fourth-wing.plot: Violet Sorrengail, small and fragile and raised to become a scribe, is forced by her mother, the commanding general, to enter Basgiath War College as a dragon rider cadet. In a school where cadets die in training and at each other's hands, she has to survive the trials, bond with a dragon and deal with Xaden Riorson, the son of an executed rebel leader who has every reason to want her dead.
fourth-wing.title: Fourth Wing

heir-of-fire.plot: Celaena has sailed to Wendlyn, where she must face the truth about her heritage and train her magic under the Fae warrior Rowan to earn answers from Queen Maeve. Back in Adarlan, Chaol and Dorian deal with the king's growing darkness, and the witch Manon Blackbeak enters the story.
heir-of-fire.title: Heir of Fire

orlando-furioso.plot: A chivalric poem in octaves set during the war between Charlemagne and the Saracens. The paladin Orlando pursues the beautiful Angelica and, on learning she has married the foot soldier Medoro, goes so mad that Astolfo has to fly to the Moon on the hippogriff to retrieve his wits. Dozens of other stories are woven around this one, above all the thwarted love between the warrior Bradamante and the Saracen Ruggiero.
orlando-furioso.title: Orlando furioso

nineteen-eighty-four.plot: In Oceania the Party controls every aspect of life under the ever-present gaze of Big Brother. Winston Smith works at the Ministry of Truth, where he rewrites old newspapers to fit the current line, and in secret begins to keep a diary and to doubt. His clandestine affair with Julia and his contact with O'Brien, who seems to be a dissenter, lead him straight into the hands of the Thought Police and into Room 101.

white-fang.plot: In the Klondike of the gold rush a cub is born three-quarters wolf and one-quarter dog. Raised in the wild, he ends up first among Grey Beaver's people, then in the hands of the cruel Beauty Smith, who turns him into a fighting dog. He is saved by Weedon Scott, who patiently wins his trust and takes him home to California.
white-fang.title: White Fang

harry-potter-4.altTitle: Harry Potter e il calice di fuoco
harry-potter-4.plot: Hogwarts hosts the Triwizard Tournament between three schools of magic, and the Goblet of Fire unexpectedly draws Harry's name too, though he is too young to enter. Forced to face dragons, the lake and a maze, Harry realises only at the end that the whole tournament was a trap. The book closes with Voldemort's return in the flesh and the first death among the students.
harry-potter-4.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

das-boot.plot: Autumn 1941. A war correspondent joins the crew of a German U-boat leaving La Rochelle for a patrol in the Atlantic. Told from inside the cramped hull, the novel follows weeks of boredom, storms and stench broken by convoy attacks and depth-charge hunts, and an order to slip through the Strait of Gibraltar that almost ends with the boat on the seabed. Buchheim drew on his own time aboard U-96.
das-boot.title: Das Boot

the-jakarta-method.plot: A work of history and reporting on the Cold War outside Europe. Bevins recounts the mass killing of around a million suspected communists in Indonesia in 1965 and 1966, carried out by the army with support from the United States. He then follows how that model of anticommunist terror was studied and repeated in Brazil, Chile and elsewhere in Latin America and Asia, drawing on declassified documents and interviews with survivors.
the-jakarta-method.title: The Jakarta Method

la-regina-dei-caraibi.plot: The Black Corsair returns to the hunt for Van Guld, joining Morgan and the filibusters in assaults on Spanish cities of the Gulf of Mexico. He is haunted by the woman he abandoned at sea and learns that she may still be alive. Revenge and love pull him in opposite directions until the two finally meet.
la-regina-dei-caraibi.title: La regina dei Caraibi

l-arte-della-guerra.plot: A short Chinese treatise on strategy in thirteen chapters, attributed to the general Sun Tzu. It is not a story but a manual. It teaches that the best victory is the one won without fighting, through knowledge of the enemy and of oneself, deception, speed, use of terrain and spies. It is still read today for its lessons on leadership, negotiation and competition.
l-arte-della-guerra.title: L'arte della guerra

lo-scudo-di-talos.plot: Born crippled to a noble Spartan family, Talos is abandoned on Mount Taygetus as the law demands and raised by a Helot shepherd among the slaves of Sparta. His brother Brithos grows up a warrior in the city below. The Persian wars, from Thermopylae to Plataea, bring the two together and force Talos to choose between the people who raised him and the blood he was born with.
lo-scudo-di-talos.title: Lo scudo di Talos

the-great-gatsby.plot: Long Island, summer of 1922. Nick Carraway rents a house next to the mansion of Jay Gatsby, a mysterious millionaire famous for his parties. Gatsby has built his whole fortune to win back Daisy Buchanan, Nick's cousin, now married to the rich and brutal Tom. The dream collides with the people it was built around.
the-great-gatsby.title: The Great Gatsby

assassins-creed-7.plot: The French Revolution told through the journals of Élise de la Serre, daughter of the Templar Grand Master, and Arno Dorian, an Assassin's orphan raised in her home. After her father's murder Élise seeks revenge inside an order that rejects her while Arno joins the brotherhood, and the two stay bound to each other despite standing on opposite sides.
assassins-creed-7.title: Assassin's Creed: Unity

harry-potter-1.altTitle: Harry Potter e la pietra filosofale
harry-potter-1.plot: Harry, an orphan raised by an aunt and uncle who mistreat him, learns at eleven that he is a wizard and famous for having survived Voldemort. At Hogwarts he befriends Ron and Hermione, and the three investigate what is hidden in the forbidden third-floor corridor: the Philosopher's Stone, which someone wants to steal to bring the Dark Lord back.
harry-potter-1.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

dune.plot: House Atreides is given control of the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the spice that makes interstellar travel possible. Betrayed by their Harkonnen rivals and by the Emperor, young Paul Atreides and his mother Jessica escape into the deep desert and are taken in by the Fremen. Among them Paul becomes Muad'Dib, the leader of a holy war to take Arrakis back.
dune.title: Dune

vanderbilt.altTitle: The Rise and Fall of an American Dynasty
vanderbilt.plot: The story of the Vanderbilt family, told by one of its descendants. It begins with Cornelius Vanderbilt, the Commodore, who built the largest fortune in America on steamboats and railroads in the nineteenth century. It then follows his heirs through the mansions and society wars of the Gilded Age as they spend the money, down to Gloria Vanderbilt, the author's mother, by which time the fortune was gone.
vanderbilt.title: Vanderbilt

the-covenant.plot: A vast historical novel that tells the story of South Africa from prehistory to the years of apartheid. It follows three families across the generations: the Afrikaner Van Doorns, the English Saltwoods and the African Nxumalos. Through them it covers the arrival of the Dutch at the Cape, the Great Trek, Shaka and the Zulu, the rush for diamonds and gold, the Boer wars and the birth of apartheid.
the-covenant.title: L'alleanza
